title: Novakai Messaging — public contract source (Step 2)
authority: Messaging-Ratification.md §9/§10; Messaging-Store-Seam.md §6 (and its §11 errata). This file is the SINGLE source of truth for every contract shape (law #3). Docs, validators, and the visual map generate from it; nothing is hand-copied into prose.

Timestamp.description: Display-only (DEC-19). Nothing in the capability orders by wall-clock.

ProviderSessionId.description: Novakai-owned stable ProviderSession identity; distinct from the provider resume handle.

ProviderResumeId.description: Provider-owned opaque resume handle. Never accepted where ProviderSessionId is required.

TranscriptSourceId.description: Opaque identity of one provider file; paths stay inside the source adapter.

EventCursor.description: Durable Messaging event cursor; deliberately distinct from page Cursor.

RequestHash.description: SHA-256 hex of the full request content: address, body, priority, template ID + fields (A5). Computed by the core, compared opaquely by the store.

errors.name: IdempotencyConflict
errors.summary: A5: same (senderId, clientMessageId) but different requestHash. Pass-through from the store seam — public by design.

errors.name: DependencyUnavailable
errors.summary: R6: typed public outcome for dependency failure. One umbrella shape; the dependency field names which seam failed. StoreUnavailable/StorageExhausted/StoreCorrupt map here (Store-Seam §6); membership-timeout and authority-failure reuse THIS shape (Messaging-Seams §2.2, §3.3); clock/ID halt-class failures use dependency=clock (Messaging-Seams §5.2). presence-transport is DELIBERATELY absent — its failures surface through the Delivery lane as typed state, a richer public outcome (Messaging-Seams §4.2). Consumers assume non-retryable unless the instance's retryable field says true; they MUST tolerate unknown dependency values (treat as non-retryable).

dependency.description: Known values: store | membership | authority | clock (clock added at Step 3b). Typed as open string, NOT an enum — additive extension is the compatibility rule and consumers MUST tolerate unknown values (treat as non-retryable). presence-transport is deliberately absent (failures surface via the Delivery lane, Messaging-Seams §4.2).

retryable.description: Per-instance flag. false for StoreCorrupt-class failures — operator intervention required. Absent/unknown → assume false.

errors.name: InvalidSendInput
errors.summary: A conversation send request failed validation before any durable write. Non-retryable; the field names which input failed so hosts can correct and resubmit.

field.description: The ConversationSendInput field that failed validation: conversationId | issuedBy | targetAgentId | clientOpId | text.

errors.name: InvalidQuery
errors.summary: A committed-query request failed validation before any read. Non-retryable; the message names which constraint failed so hosts can correct and resubmit. Distinct from DependencyUnavailable: the caller asked for something impossible, so retrying changes nothing.

query.description: The committed query that failed validation, e.g. listAgentCommunications.

errors.name: UnknownTargetAgent
errors.summary: The addressed Agent does not exist in the Agent directory. Non-retryable; the host should refresh its agent list before resubmitting.
